items.headline: Bitmine adds 32,447 ETH and reports holdings above 5.84 million ETH
items.summary: Bitmine Immersion said it acquired another 32,447 ETH over the prior week, taking total holdings to 5,847,611 ETH, while more than 5.06 million ETH is staked. The latest addition is worth roughly $81.5 million at contemporaneous prices and reinforces ongoing corporate ETH accumulation, but it follows a very sharp weekly ETH advance.
items.whyItMatters: Bitmine is the largest disclosed corporate ETH treasury and the purchase adds a further institutional demand signal. However, the incremental purchase is small relative to its existing treasury and does not by itself justify a HIGH impact classification or a fresh entry after ETH's vertical expansion.
items.actionReason: Use as supportive institutional-flow context only. The latest available Crypto Reca scan at 14:03 Madrid had ETH at D2 / ERS 87 / Entry 4 of 5 but explicitly blocked a new entry on CHASE/RR grounds after the 2,509 spike; this news does not override that technical block.

items.headline: Strategy raises about $2 billion through MSTR sales but makes no bitcoin purchase and builds a new $1.59 billion USD Cash pool
items.summary: Strategy reported no bitcoin purchase or sale for Aug. 17-23 despite raising about $2 billion through MSTR sales; it increased its USD reserve to $5.1 billion and established a separate $1.59 billion USD Cash pool. Holdings remain 840,447 BTC at a $75,385 average acquisition price.
items.whyItMatters: Strategy is one of the largest corporate bitcoin holders, so the absence of fresh buying despite substantial equity issuance removes a potential marginal demand source for now. The large cash pool also preserves future purchasing capacity, so this is not equivalent to a bearish BTC sale.
items.actionReason: Do not treat the corporate purchase pause as an exit signal or as a reason to override the latest Crypto Reca technical setup. The 14:03 Madrid Radar independently had BTC at D2 / ERS 89 / Entry 5 of 5 as a conditional CORE add-on candidate near its validated retest zone, subject to fresh Coinbase Advanced Preview and no-chase discipline.

items.headline: Bitcoin posts largest weekly dollar gain on record after 22.7% advance
items.summary: Bitcoin gained $14,264 during the week ended Aug. 23 and closed the week at $77,387, a 22.7% seven-day rise. The move confirms powerful momentum but also materially increases extension and FOMO/chase risk after the advance.
items.whyItMatters: Record weekly momentum is supportive for the existing higher-timeframe BTC trend, but a 22.7% weekly rise makes fresh entries more vulnerable to chasing and mean-reversion risk.
items.actionReason: Latest Crypto Reca scan at 14:03 Madrid independently upgraded BTC to an analytically valid CORE add-on candidate after completed 1H acceptance above 78k, but only around the validated 78.15k-78.30k retest/hold area and subject to a fresh Coinbase Advanced Preview. The positive news still does not justify chasing materially above that zone.

items.headline: Bitcoin and Ether ETFs posted their strongest combined inflow week since October 2025
items.summary: U.S. spot BTC ETFs recorded about $1.9B of weekly net inflows and spot ETH ETFs about $697.2M, with combined trading volume rising to roughly $29B. The flow reversal is materially supportive, but it followed a sharp weekly price rally and does not by itself justify chasing.
items.whyItMatters: Large renewed institutional spot-ETF demand can support liquidity and trend persistence in BTC and ETH, but the move comes after a large rally and therefore raises chase risk.
items.actionReason: Treat the inflows as supportive context for existing long exposure, not as an independent entry trigger; require Crypto Reca location/trigger confirmation before adding. BTC now has conditional technical confirmation in the latest scan, while ETH remains blocked by location/RR after vertical expansion.

items.headline: Solana mainnet begins staged slot-time reduction toward 200 ms
items.summary: Solana cut mainnet target slot time to 350 ms, down from 400 ms, as part of a staged reduction toward 200 ms. Solana status reports the mainnet cluster operational with no recent network incident, so the upgrade currently reads as constructive protocol context rather than an operational-risk event.
items.whyItMatters: Lower slot times can improve confirmation latency and network competitiveness, but it is primarily a protocol-quality development rather than a direct flow catalyst.
items.actionReason: Use only as supportive protocol context. Latest Crypto Reca scan still has SOL as OPEN REAL TACTICAL / NO ADD / EXIT REVIEW because the original Tactical thesis was already invalidated; the rebound does not repair that history retrospectively.

catalysts.headline: U.S. July PCE inflation and Personal Income/Outlays release
catalysts.whyItMatters: The PCE price index is released in the Personal Income and Outlays report and is a key inflation input for Federal Reserve policy expectations; a material surprise can rapidly move Treasury yields, the dollar and crypto risk appetite.
catalysts.preparationNote: No entry restriction yet. Reassess event risk inside 24h and move to PREPARE VOLATILITY as the release approaches.

catalysts.headline: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh keynote at Jackson Hole
catalysts.whyItMatters: A Jackson Hole keynote by the Fed Chair can materially shift expectations for rates, liquidity and risk assets, including crypto.
catalysts.preparationNote: No need to avoid entries yet solely because of this event; tighten event awareness as the speech approaches and reassess within 24h.
